title: PaymentWebhookRequest
description: JSON-RPC params for the payment webhook handler. payment_capture and payment_transfer auto-call it in-process after capture/transfer; tests call it explicitly; real Stripe events arrive at POST /webhooks/stripe and are translated into these internal types (e.g. payment_intent.succeeded → payment_intent.capture_succeeded). Event names mirror Stripe stages with unambiguous internal names. Payload uses payment_intent_id as the correlation key for every transaction row of a payment.

payment_intent_id.description: The payment_provider_transaction_id from the intent row; ties every lifecycle row together.
